description: This file defines challenge type constants, mappings for challenge views, submission types, and utility functions related to challenge types in a coding platform.

methods.name: hasNoSolution
methods.description: Determines if a challenge type has no solution based on predefined list.

methods.name: getIsDailyCodingChallenge
methods.description: Checks if a challenge type is a daily coding challenge.

methods.name: getDailyCodingChallengeLanguage
methods.description: Returns the programming language for a daily challenge type.
